title: Top 5 Customers by Revenue
description: You are working with an e-commerce database. Find the top 5 customers by total order revenue, along with the number of orders they placed. Return customer name, total revenue, and order count, sorted by total revenue descending.

question: Write a SQL query to find the top 5 customers by total order revenue. Return customer name (as 'customer_name'), total revenue (as 'total_revenue'), and number of orders (as 'order_count'). Only include completed orders. Sort by total_revenue descending.
expectedQuery: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
